resources.name: Library
resources.location: 525 Falconer Street, Jamestown; 260 North Union Street, Olean
resources.hours: Jamestown: Monday-Thursday: 8 a.m. - 6 p.m. & Friday: 8 a.m. - 4 p.m.; Cattaraugus: Monday-Thursday: 8 a.m.-4 p.m., Friday: 8 a.m.-1 p.m.
resources.description: Reference librarians and library staff can help you with basic questions via chat, frequently asked questions, and phone. If you need more extensive assistance with your research, you are encouraged to visit one of the campus libraries.

resources.name: Academic Advising
resources.description: Advisors assist students with academic, career, and transfer planning, and are available to all JCC students. Success Navigators assist students in the transition to college and connect them to advisors and other resources

resources.name: Student Food Pantry
resources.location: Jamestown Campus: next to the Campus Bookstore, Hamilton Collegiate Center, first floor; Cattaraugus County Campus: Success Center across from the bookstore, College Center, first floor
resources.description: Jamestown Community College maintains a food pantry for all students on the Jamestown Campus and Cattaraugus County Campus. We have an assortment of donated food items and hygiene products that we are happy to share.

resources.name: Health Center
resources.location: Jamestown Campus: COCE 122; Cattaraugus County Campus: COLL 139
resources.description: At Jamestown Community College, our health centers are dedicated to supporting the health and well-being of all students and employees. Our team is here to assist you if you're feeling unwell with a seasonal illness like influenza, RSV, or COVID-19, or have other health concerns.

resources.name: Financial Aid Office
resources.description: JCC Financial Aid & Billing helps students understand their financial aid, student bill, and the different options available to help pay for college. Students can also use this office for questions about FAFSA, financial aid requirements, and their financial aid status.

resources.name: IT Help Desk
resources.description: The Jamestown Community College IT Help Desk serves as the central point of contact for technology support across all JCC campuses. It provides essential technical assistance to students, faculty, and staff to ensure seamless access to the college's digital environment.

resources.name: Campus Bookstore
resources.location: JCC Campus Store. 525 Falconer Street. Jamestown. NY 14701
resources.hours: Mon-Thu: 9:00 AM - 4:30 PM. Fri: 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM. Sat-Sun: Closed
resources.description: Provides textbooks. campus merchandise. supplies. and customer support for courses.

resources.name: Campus Safety
resources.hours: Contact office or campus safety cell for active hours
resources.description: Handles emergency situations. incident reporting. campus safety. and security support.

resources.name: Career Services
resources.location: Jamestown Campus and Cattaraugus County Campus (Olean)
resources.description: Assists students with career advice. job searches. career preparation. and campus visits.
